title: Kali Ketiga Di JPJ
mood: nervous, self-deprecating, tender toward a father
subject: third attempt at the driving test
caption: Sarawakian folk pop built on sape. Plucked sape lute carrying the main figure with its natural woody buzz left in, nylon-string guitar strummed lightly behind it, soft hand percussion on a shallow frame drum, upright bass played with fingers not pick, one sustained bowed cello note under the chorus. Recorded dry and close with almost no reverb, sape panned slightly left of the voice. Warm close male tenor, conversational and slightly nervous, breath left in, no vibrato. 88 BPM, D major. Anxious but affectionate. No pop production, no synth, no drum machine, no gamelan, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - sape alone]

[Verse 1]
Pukul lapan pagi, baju kemeja yang sama
Nombor dua belas, aku dah hafal dinding ni
Pakcik penguji tak pandang muka aku
Dia pandang tangan aku kat stereng

[Pre-Chorus]
Bukit tiga penjuru dah kutawan dalam mimpi
Tapi kaki aku sendiri yang menipu aku

[Chorus]
Kali ketiga, bah
Aku bukan takut gagal
Aku takut balik rumah dan ayah tanya "macam mana?"
dengan suara yang terlalu lembut

[Verse 2]
Kereta sekolah memandu, bau pewangi murah
Cermin belakang longgar sikit, aku pegang dengan jari
Kawan aku dah lulus, dia hantar gambar lesen
Aku bagi satu emoji. Cukup.

[Chorus]
Kali ketiga, bah
Aku bukan takut gagal
Aku takut balik rumah dan ayah tanya "macam mana?"
dengan suara yang terlalu sabar

[Bridge - sape and voice only]
Kalau lulus pun, aku nak pandu ke mana?
Jalan ni aku dah hafal sampai tak perlu lesen

[Outro - sape, stopping]
Nombor dua belas. Masuk.
